description: Save what the user just approved — anything `record`, `split`, `plan`, `invite` or `invest` prepared — or discard it. Only call this after they have said yes or no themselves. Saving records it in Bluu; it never moves money or pays anyone. Some things can only be approved in Bluu; for those, offer the link instead. What it saves comes back with a `ref` when it can be changed or deleted from this chat later.

changes.description: Corrections the USER asked for, e.g. {"amount": "38900"}.

decision.description: confirm saves it; cancel discards it.

proposal_ref.description: The short proposal reference returned when prepared. Do not display it.

token.description: Legacy proposal handle, for older conversations only. Do not display it.

name: confirm
title: Save or Discard a Proposal
